description:
Stop hand-maintaining the machine-readable pricing tables, and detect upstream drift automatically. This is the mechanism that stops the subsystem returning to its current state in 90 days.

Must land AFTER the data is corrected. Both external reviewers independently found that introducing the drift guard alongside still-wrong data is impossible: the guard fails against the very data it protects, and the only way to make it pass would be to stub the generator to emit known-wrong values.

Add scripts/generate_pricing_data.py following the established repo idiom - a regenerate mode plus a --check mode that regenerates in memory and exits non-zero on drift. Precedents: scripts/generate_compat_docs.py:294-312, scripts/generate_query_docs.py:428-449, scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py:286-301. It belongs in top-level scripts/ (sibling of generate_compat_docs.py) rather than _project/scripts/, because its output ships in the wheel.

Generated: redshift_node_prices and athena_price_per_tb from the AWS Price List API; synapse_dedicated_dwu_prices, synapse_serverless_price_per_tb, fabric_cu_prices and the Azure Databricks block from the Azure Retail Prices API. Hand-maintained with their own provenance and a manual_review_due date: BigQuery, Snowflake, Firebolt, Databricks AWS/GCP.

Wiring, all enforced and all of which fail CI if skipped: Make targets pricing-data / pricing-data-check following make/documentation.mk:89-104; register both in make/inventory.json, since make/check_makefile_inventory.py fails on an unregistered target; add to the guards-fix meta-target (Makefile:644-682); name the CI step guard-pricing-data in .github/workflows/pr.yml, which the aggregator at pr.yml:594-635 discovers by prefix and fails closed - no other wiring needed.

The network-touching refresh must not sit in the PR-blocking path. pytest.ini:18 excludes live_integration by default; model the scheduled job on .github/workflows/submission-validator-drift-check.yml:11-23.

Watch the duplicate-code delta gate: make duplicate-check-delta fails on any positive duplicated-line delta, and a generator closely modeled on generate_compat_docs.py may trip clone detection.
